extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed phenotype/mechanism ontology from primary XML/PDF locators; no molecular target overclaim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NCR335 and NCR169 peptide fragments show source-tabulated anticandidal growth inhibition against Candida strains by micro-dilution MIC assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports antifungal phenotype, not a molecular target or membrane-permeabilization mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Selected peptides reduce or abolish Candida hyphal growth at sub-lethal concentrations in microscopy assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology shift is a virulence phenotype; the paper does not identify a direct molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The anticandidal peptide derivatives inhibit Candida biofilm formation in XTT viability assays and reduce biofilm structural complexity in SEM images.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm inhibition is not promoted to a molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Checkerboard assays show additive or synergistic interactions for selected peptide/fluconazole and peptide/peptide combinations against Candida auris.
mechanism_claims.limitations: FIC synergy reduces effective concentrations but does not define the biochemical mechanism.
